part.text:
Implemented the `Str::trim()` fix in `src/Illuminate/Support/Str.php`.

- Default trimming now includes NUL (`\x00`) for ASCII and UTF-8 inputs, matching PHP `trim()` behavior while retaining Laravel’s extended Unicode whitespace support.
- Confirmed the reported fluent case: `str(" \0 ")->trim()->toString()` returns `''`.
- Verified with:
  - `tests/Support/SupportStrTest.php --filter testTrim` (passes)
  - `tests/Support/SupportStringableTest.php --filter testTrim` (passes)
  - `git diff --check` (passes)

The full `SupportStringableTest` suite has one unrelated existing error: missing `Illuminate\Tests\Support\StringableObjectStub` in `testIs`.
